Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: Manager submitted a mid-cycle contractor->FT conversion with a requested effective_date 2025-01-15 and wants backpay to 2024-12-01. Need quick checklist and payroll cutoff notes for APAC/EMEA/NA. @Jon @Pri
Jon (Comp): Summary: doable if retro month payroll not closed. Need comp-change ticket, evidence pack, payroll CSV with region tag, and Finance signoff for >20% increases or >1 band.
Pri (Payroll): Cutoffs (approx): EMEA 2024-12-15 17:00 UTC, APAC 2024-12-18 17:00 local, NA 2024-12-20 00:00 UTC. Missed cutoff -> off-cycle one-time payment next run (~2 weeks delay) and extra GL approvals.
Ellen (Manager): What exactly goes in the evidence pack?
Jon (Comp): Evidence pack: signed offer, manager rationale (2 sentences), 3 performance highlights, org chart snippet, contractor invoice range + termination confirmation. Attach headcount approval ID.
Maya (People Ops): For equity: normally service_date = effective_date if retro <90 days; otherwise escalate to Legal. Benefits usually start next calendar month after effective_date if retro.
Pri (Payroll): Also include payroll CSV sample row and GL code when invoice/payslip currency differ. If you hit HRIS validation errors, screenshot and ping payroll.
Ops Bot: Reminder: use conversion-offcycle template and add payroll_tag OFFC_CONV_EMEA / OFFC_CONV_APAC / OFFC_CONV_NA. Template link: https://hris.internal/redwood/templates/conversion-offcycle
Ellen (Manager): I'll aim to submit by 2024-12-10 to avoid off-cycle. Thanks team.
Maya (People Ops): Great—once submitted post the ticket number in this thread so we can track approvals and payroll tagging. :white_check_mark:
